correctness.rationale: Precisely defined C_n includes the n=1 loop case. Every cutoff k<=2q has an explicit FO2 sentence of rank <=q, with k=1 and k=2 special cases; for odd k=2r+1 the red radius-r ball covers exactly cycles of length <=k; for even k=2r+4 a closed one-step ball around a second center adds at most three positions. For n,m>=2q+1 a two-pebble game strategy preserves radius-t marked-location labels as t decreases. The one-step matching lemma uses a radius-(t-1) interior containing at least four points, leaving at least one after excluding stationary and two neighbors. This proves all large structures equivalent. A standalone exhaustive exact FO2-type checker (all 0-,1-,2-variable assignments) verifies ranks 0..7 and lengths 1..20; explicit formulas verified k<=14 and lengths 1..34. Finite checks corroborate rather than replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: A sharp, natural, complete invariant is established for a fundamental FO2 class: exactly 2q+1 rank-q theories and exact collapse beyond length 2q. The cycle has both a uniquely named origin and no visible linear order, which highlights the expressivity boundary between order-free two-variable navigation, unmarked paths, and full FO rankers. Explicit cutoff formulas supply optimal witnesses for every shorter length; the paired matching lemma explains the structural obstruction to larger-size distinctions. These details are not an arbitrary numerical slice, code-only observation, or restatement of a general satisfiability bound.
